about.title: ABOUT ELETROTECH
about.text1: We started our activities in August 2018, now completing 8 years. Initially, we only worked with rewinding and maintenance of electric motors and water pumps. Over time, we improved and expanded into new areas such as automation and electrical projects in industrial and fish farming sectors.
about.text2: We are committed to delivery deadlines and strive for excellence and quality in service. One of our main differentials is after-hours service, at special times including overnight.

featured.title: DISSOLVED OXYGEN PROBE
featured.description: Oxygen monitoring and control system for fish tanks. Separated into four aerator groups that turn on and off independently according to the producer's needs and programming. Remote access via smartphone app.
featured.f1: Up to 3 probes on one panel
